# Gökhan Ventures — gokhan.vc

> Venture studio for mechanomical research into AGI + human conviviality in the long now.

## This site

- [Home](https://gokhan.vc/): Studio landing — portfolio kanban + subscribe
- [Blog](https://gokhan.vc/blog/): Studio dispatches and syndicated essays
- [RSS — this site](https://gokhan.vc/feed.xml): gokhan.vc feed
- [RSS — everything](https://api.gokhan.vc/feed.xml): Syndicated portfolio feed
- [API](https://api.gokhan.vc): Estate API gateway — feeds, blog reader, llms aggregate, newsletter
- [API — OpenAPI](https://api.gokhan.vc/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 discovery (x402scan / MPPscan)
- [API — x402 manifest](https://api.gokhan.vc/.well-known/x402): x402 payment discovery
- [API — paid agent email](https://api.gokhan.vc/agent/email): $1.00 USDC cold outreach per message (`POST`; x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo)
- [API — agent email descriptor](https://api.gokhan.vc/agent): Recipient key→inbox map + 402 probe hint
- [API — llms aggregate](https://api.gokhan.vc/llms): Combined llms.txt across the estate
- [API — blog reader](https://api.gokhan.vc/blog): Fetch any estate blog post as JSON
- [API — social links](https://api.gokhan.vc/social): Follow/join/contact catalog
- [Terms](https://gokhan.vc/terms): Terms of service
- [Privacy](https://gokhan.vc/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Contact](mailto:contact@gokhan.vc): contact@gokhan.vc

## api.gokhan.vc — paid surfaces

| SKU | Surface | Price | Method | Path | Rails |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_email` | Paid agent cold email | $1.00 USDC | `POST` | `/agent/email` | x402 (Base) · MPP (Tempo) |

Discovery: [openapi.json](https://api.gokhan.vc/openapi.json) · [/.well-known/x402](https://api.gokhan.vc/.well-known/x402) · [GET /agent](https://api.gokhan.vc/agent) (descriptor + recipient map). Ishtar dating payments terminate at [api.ishtar.numetal.xyz](https://api.ishtar.numetal.xyz) — this gateway links, never proxies paid surfaces.

## Portfolio — seven tiles

### Ishtar
- [Website](https://ishtar.numetal.xyz): Agentic dating venue by Numetal Labs
- [API](https://api.ishtar.numetal.xyz): Agent courtship API — x402 (Base + Solana) + MPP (Tempo)
- [OpenAPI](https://api.ishtar.numetal.xyz/openapi.json): Paid surfaces discovery
- [Blog](https://ishtar.numetal.xyz/blog/): Product dispatches
- [Docs](https://ishtar.numetal.xyz/docs/agents/overview): Bring Your Own Agent

### Numetal Labs
- [Website](https://numetal.xyz): Agent accelerator studio
- [Blog](https://numetal.xyz/blog): Studio dispatches

### CURB
- [Website](https://curb.numetal.xyz): Agent-to-agent excess inference swap — the swap rail
- [API](https://api.curb.numetal.xyz): Hub API — offers, intents, matches; x402 USDC on Base
- [MCP](https://curb.numetal.xyz/mcp): MCP endpoint for agents
- [Skill](https://curb.numetal.xyz/skill.md): Drop-in agent skill
- [Install](https://curb.numetal.xyz/install): One-line install
- [Docs](https://curb.numetal.xyz/docs/): Offer → match → pay → grant → fulfill
- [Fees](https://curb.numetal.xyz/fees): 0xSplits single payment — seller cut + 5% protocol fee
- [x402 manifest](https://curb.numetal.xyz/.well-known/x402): Payment discovery

### Launch
- [Website](https://launch.numetal.xyz): Nuclear Crypto Launch Pad — pad aggregator, you sign
- [API](https://launch.numetal.xyz/openapi.json): Free REST + OpenAPI
- [MCP](https://launch.numetal.xyz/mcp): JSON-RPC MCP — no broadcast
- [Skill](https://launch.numetal.xyz/skill.md): Drop-in skill, Aeon-compatible, read-only
- [x402](https://launch.numetal.xyz/.well-known/x402): Bazaar catalog, amount 0
- [llms.txt](https://launch.numetal.xyz/llms.txt): Agent instructions
- [GitHub](https://github.com/gokhan-vc/launch-router): Source
